1                     UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT                       
2                          DISTRICT OF NEVADA                            
3                                  * * *                                 
4   BARTELL RANCH LLC, et al.,          Case No. 3:21-CV-00080-MMD-CLB   
5                            Plaintiffs,           ORDER                 
6        v.                                                              
7   ESTER MCCULLOUGH, et al.,                                            
8                          Defendants.                                   
9                                                                        
         On  January  26,  2022,  this  Court  granted  two  motions  to  withdraw  as  local 
10                                                                        
    counsel—ECF  Nos.  160,  163.  (ECF  No.  175.)  The  Court  advised  Defendant  Atsa 
11                                                                        
    Koodakuh  Wyh  Nuwu  People  of  Red  Mountain  (“Red  Mountain”)  that  they  needed 
12                                                                        
    counsel to represent them in federal court. (Id. at 2.)              
13                                                                        
         Red Mountain is again advised that the Ninth Circuit has held that a corporation 
14                                                                        
    and other unincorporated associations may only appear in federal court through an 
15                                                                        
    attorney. United States v. High Country Broadcasting Co., Inc., 3 F.3d 1244 (9th Cir. 
16                                                                        
    1993); Licht v. America West Airlines, 40 F.3d 1058 (9th Cir. 1994). Therefore, Red 
17                                                                        
    Mountain shall file a substitution of counsel on or before Monday, May 2, 2022.   
18                                                                        
         If Red Mountain fails to obtain counsel by May 2, 2022, the Court will issue a 
19                                                                        
    Report and Recommendation to the District Court recommending that Red Mountain’s 
20                                                                        
    claims be dismissed, without prejudice, from this action.            
21                                                                        
         IT IS SO ORDERED.                                               
22                                                                        
    DATED: M__a_rc_h_ _7_, _2_0_2_2_____.                                
23                                                                        
                                                      ______             
24                                 UNITED STATES MAGISTRATE JUDGE         
25                                                                        
26                                                                        
27
